acceptance_criteria.criterion: Removal is explicit and traceable; endpoints are not silently omitted.
Repository/source/client/config/documentation/deployment dependency inventory is complete and every dependency is dispositioned.
Supported HG2 public interface and removal behavior are documented; no undocumented compatibility shim remains.
Canonical hg-genesis and source/evidence history remain unchanged.

tests.purpose: Inventory candidate and legacy route definitions and record exact findings.
tests.expected: Route presence/absence is evidenced from source and actual router, not inferred from one-tree grep.

tests.purpose: Search available sources, configs, docs and client material for endpoint consumers.
tests.expected: Each consumer is migrated, retired by explicit decision, or blocks acceptance.

tests.purpose: Integration-test the actual candidate HTTP server/router.
tests.expected: Removed endpoints are not served; resulting status/error behavior is documented; remaining routes pass.
No regression caused by endpoint removal; tests pass on exact candidate SHA.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact Bridge 1.1 capabilities and security/authority/evidence responsibilities are inventoried from source and protocol documents.
All consumers and operational dependencies are identified and dispositioned; no required workflow is silently lost.
Removal is explicitly documented and does not imply the capabilities exist elsewhere.
HG2 phone-primary authority, fail-closed behavior, durable history and evidence integrity remain covered by regression tests.
No repository, branch, tag or historical evidence is deleted or archived as part of this scope decision.

tests.purpose: Compare original Bridge 1.1 source/protocol capabilities with HG2 source/tests.
tests.expected: Every capability is intentionally removed, independently evidenced as replaced, or unresolved; no implicit equivalence.

tests.purpose: Search call sites, clients, configs, docs and workflows for bridge dependencies.
tests.expected: All consumers are retired or dispositioned; any unresolved consumer blocks acceptance.

tests.purpose: Run fail-closed authority/authentication and history integrity regression tests.
tests.expected: Security and durability regressions pass on exact candidate SHA.

tests.purpose: Audit runtime capability declarations and user-facing docs.
tests.expected: No removed capability is claimed available without separate proof.

mapping.rule: HG is the durable/event identity; HG2 is the product/repository label. Never silently rewrite historical product_id values.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: PRODUCT_ID remains exactly HG in identity and history modules.
Formal mapping HG durable/event identity to HG2 product/repository label is consistent across contract, product metadata and operator-facing docs without changing durable ID.
Identity tests prove events, projections, replay output and audit exports retain product_id=HG.
Existing stores with product_id=HG reopen and verify without migration or history rewrite.
No implicit product_id=HG2 conversion; future migration requires a separate decision and contract.

tests.purpose: Unit-test PRODUCT_ID and formal mapping contract.
tests.expected: PRODUCT_ID == HG and declared product_name == HG2.

tests.purpose: Create, replay, verify and audit-export a fresh store.
tests.expected: Durable/event identity remains HG; HG2 is metadata/product label only.

tests.purpose: Reopen and verify a pre-existing HG fixture.
tests.expected: Verification succeeds without rewriting event bytes or product_id.

tests.purpose: Static-scan identity-bearing code, metadata and docs.
tests.expected: No unapproved HG-to-HG2 durable identity conversion.

global_gates.requirement: All implementation acceptance tests and CI pass on exact candidate SHA.
Reviewer other than author reviews exact candidate SHA.
Provenance is independently verifiable; unsigned commits are never described as signed.
Production authentication and applicable VPS/HTTPS/device E2E gates have evidence.

evidence_rule: This record is owner-approved scope only, not implementation/test/review evidence or readiness certification. Remain BLOCKED/NO-GO until applicable criteria have evidence tied to the exact candidate SHA. The product-ID mapping metadata and its unit assertion passed locally before commit; this is not exact-SHA or CI evidence.
